content.short: Aqua Protocol (CDP) is a TON borrowing protocol for minting AquaUSD from over-collateralized assets.
content.description: Aqua Protocol (CDP) represents the AquaUSD borrowing side of Aqua Protocol on TON. Public TON listings describe it as a CDP system with fixed fees and an over-collateralized stablecoin backed by LST, LP, and RWA collateral. The public domain now shows the Upscale Telegram prop-trading product, so this registry entry uses the verified Aqua CDP description while flagging the changed live website context. Upscale is the first prop-trading platform fully integrated into Telegram mini-apps.
